content.title: EXCEPTION MANAGEMENT & QUALITY WORKFLOW
content.content:
- **Failed record store**: Failed records (validation errors, target-system rejection) are written to configurable error targets (database table, file, message queue) with the full original record, the failed rule, the error message, and a timestamp. No valid data is lost: no processing stops.

- **Authorisation-based reprocessing**: SnapLogic's Triggered Task API enables AH to build approval and reprocessing workflows — a data steward reviews quarantined records via an external application, approves corrections, and triggers a reprocessing pipeline via API. SnapLogic provides the execution substrate; the approval UI is built by AH or third-party software.

- **DQ trend monitoring**: Pipeline execution statistics (error rates, record counts, rejection rates per pipeline) are tracked over time in the monitoring console and integrated dashboards. Supports trend-based alerting in observability infrastructure via Splunk dashboards or Grafana dashboards over SnapLogic's existing BI infrastructure. Note: SnapLogic does not include a dedicated DQ visualisation module — AH's existing observability tooling (Grafana, Kibana, Splunk) serves as the visualisation layer.
